Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Nikhil - 9 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Pihu - 13 years, daughter
Look: glasses, blue dress
3. Anita - 38 years, mother
Look: green saree

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The terrace - a water tank, a clothes line
3. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Nikhil stands in the courtyard. Anita stands near him.]

Anita: "Nikhil, what's the plan today?"

[Nikhil sings a song.]

Anita: "Careful!"

[Nikhil thinks for a moment.]

Nikhil (excited): "Careful!"

[Dark clouds gather in the sky.]

Nikhil: "How beautiful!"

[Nikhil milks the cow.]

Anita: "This is amazing!"

[Nikhil trips on the step and scrapes his knee; it bleeds.]

Nikhil: "Mom, look at this."

Scene 2: The terrace - Day

[Nikhil stands on the terrace. Anita stands near him.]

Nikhil: "Let's begin."

[Nikhil flies a kite on the terrace.]

Nikhil (excited): "Exactly right."

Scene 3: The living room - Day

[Pihu stands in the living room. Nikhil and Anita stand near her.]

Pihu: "Nikhil, look over here."

[Pihu applies kajal to her eyes.]

Pihu (gently): "One more time!"

[Nikhil types on his laptop.]

Anita (gently): "Yes, all right."

[Nikhil slams the door shut.]

Pihu: "What next?"

[Nikhil opens the window.]

Anita: "I really enjoyed today."
